name: skill_forge_run
description: Orchestrate the full skill-forge pipeline (code.plan -> code.forge -> code.review -> code.validate)
author: ClaudeClockwork

archetype.description: One of: scanner, validator, reporter, transformer, registry_helper

allowed_write_roots.description: List of paths where code may write. None = use policy-derived safe defaults

target_root.description: Final destination for validated artifacts. None = auto-generate in .claude/forge_outputs/<run_id>

report_file.description: Where to write the run report. None = auto-generate as report_file within target_root

publish.description: If True, move validated artifacts to target_root after validation

returns.description: Stage-structured result with run_id, all stage outputs, and final_status
